colors.strategy: Preserve the existing identity. Use deep maroon and warm brown for key brand moments and serifs, white and light grey for expansive negative space and backgrounds, near-black for body text.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Implement multiple separate pages (/, /community, /art, /projects, /leadership, /work, /contact) using React Router.
Implement 'Titan City' exactly as specified on the Projects page: first featured item, embedded YouTube video (ID Ng4upY_2MVQ), thumbnail as image.
The Contact form must simulate saving to a database or handle the submission appropriately.
Ensure 'AB' monogram is created as an SVG in the components and used in header/footer/favicon.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Avoid the center-everything disease. Asymmetry creates tension and interest.
